findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_signals, ask, get_quote, unfurl_watch, save_watch, get_watch_feed, get_desk_feed, propose_topic · Private data: traverse, get_entity, get_topic_record, ask, get_corroborated, get_record, get_calibration, get_quote, create_order, get_account, unfurl_watch, save_watch, send_feedback, propose_topic · Public sink: ask, get_answer, get_quote, unfurl_watch, save_watch, retire_watch, send_feedback, propose_topic · Destructive: start_here, get_corroborated, unfurl_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_signals, ask, get_quote, unfurl_watch, save_watch, get_watch_feed, get_desk_feed, propose_topic · Private data: traverse, get_entity, get_topic_record, ask, get_corroborated, get_record, get_calibration, get_quote, create_order, get_account, unfurl_watch, save_watch, send_feedback, propose_topic · Public sink: ask, get_answer, get_quote, unfurl_watch, save_watch, retire_watch, send_feedback, propose_topic · Destructive: start_here, get_corroborated, unfurl_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
